author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a round face with two dot eyes and a zipper mouth (line, two teeth, slider pull hanging at the right); reads as the zipper-mouth emoji. The rejected drawing had a D-shaped blob mouth and an open head outline. A first version had teeth too short (read as plus signs); lengthened.
omissions: Only two teeth and a straight pull (instead of five teeth and a rounded tab overlapping the rim) fit within radius 12 of the centre.
drawing_plan: CIRCLE r20; eyes dots (18,15)/(30,15); zipper line y 26 x 13..31 with teeth x 15/23 (y 23..29) and pull (31,26)-(31,31).
